name: Life Draining Thunder OLD
description: Thassilonian runes set with onyx erupt with negative energy and thunderous roars at the presence of a living creature.
disable: DC 35 Thievery (master) to destroy the key rune, DC 37 Arcana (master) to harmlessly discharge the runes, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the trap

generalAbilities.name: Thunderous Lifedrain
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 5 feet of either double door

Effect All living creatures in the room take 9d6 Void Damage damage and 9d6 Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw).
